parchment.$description: Parchment — Page canvas and hairline borders — the warm off-white that unifies every surface and defines every divider at 1px

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, input fields, pill button fills — pure white sits one level above the warm canvas

sand.$description: Sand — Secondary surface for table rows, inset panels, and tonal contrast between stacked cards

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, icons, and logo — near-black for maximum contrast against parchment and paper

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary text, muted labels, chart axis lines, non-active icon strokes

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Primary action fill — dark filled buttons and active navigation state, white text reverses on top

moss.$description: Moss — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases

hedvig-letters-sans.$description: Body text, navigation, labels, buttons, and mid-weight headings. The positive letter-spacing (0.05em at small sizes, 0.025em at large) creates a distinctive editorial voice — most interfaces tighten spacing as size grows, this one widens it. Weight 400 for prose, 500 for labels and nav links.

hedvig-letters-serif.$description: Display headings and section titles. The serif/sans contrast is the signature editorial moment — 72px serif with -0.025em tracking sits above spaced sans-serif body. Weight stays at 400 even at display size; the font carries authority through form, not weight.
